name: @livecore/design-tokens
description: Generic, product-neutral design tokens and theme contracts for LiveCore vertical apps: the token contract (color, spacing, typography, radius, shadow, breakpoint, motion), the stable scale keys, a neutral base theme and a type-safe theme authoring helper.

scripts.test: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test tests/design-tokens.build.test.mjs
